meta.title: Why hire Andy Papadopoulos
meta.description: A concise pitch deck for employers and agencies — full-stack engineering, infrastructure, and shipped work in Melbourne.

slides.headline: Why hire Andy Papadopoulos
slides.note: Scroll or use ← → to move through the deck.

slides.headline: You get someone who ships, owns the stack, and leaves code maintainable.
slides.body: Senior developer at Mecca Medialight by day; civic tools and creative experiments under Anthemic by night. The through-line is the same: clear systems, honest delivery, and work you can hand to the next engineer.

bullets.title: Ship
bullets.text: Web apps and APIs from design conversation to production — React, TypeScript, Node, Laravel, CI/CD, and cloud deployment.

bullets.title: Own
bullets.text: Infrastructure architecture, observability-minded releases, and the unglamorous glue (auth, data integrity, moderation workflows) that keeps products trustworthy.

bullets.title: Maintain
bullets.text: Code and docs written for the team that inherits the project — not demo-ware that collapses after launch.

slides.headline: Mecca Medialight
slides.role: Senior developer · full-stack engineer · infrastructure architect
slides.body: Melbourne studio building custom websites and web applications for organisations and businesses. Lean delivery, Laravel backends, modern front ends, and engineering discipline that survives handover.
slides.stack: Laravel · modern front ends · CI/CD · AWS & Azure

slides.headline: Breadth with depth where it counts
slides.body: All skills from the hub profile — most in-demand first.

slides.headline: Safer Murray Road — SWARM Reporter
bullets: Mobile-friendly public incident reporting — live on a shoestring budget in weeks.
Interactive maps for geolocated incidents — evidence-quality views for residents and Council.
Moderation, statistics, and email alerting — data integrity for government stakeholders.

slides.headline: Anthemic proves initiative
slides.body: Side projects are not résumé filler — they are where new stacks get tested and ownership stays sharp.

projects.title: Set List Generator
projects.desc: Flagship build — React, Vite, Spring Boot API.

projects.title: Morning Macro
projects.desc: Markets dashboard — live quotes and watchlists.

slides.headline: Principles, not platitudes
bullets: Start from the user and the operator — who files the report, who moderates it, who maintains the deploy.
Prefer small, verifiable slices over big-bang launches.
Mentor where I can; document what would otherwise live in one person's head.
Treat accessibility, security, and performance as defaults, not stretch goals.

slides.headline: Strong match when you need…
bullets: A senior full-stack engineer who can also reason about infrastructure and release pipelines.
Someone comfortable across agency pace — multiple clients, clear handover, no heroics required.
A builder for civic, mapping, or data-heavy products who has done it in production, not slides.
A calm collaborator — direct communication, honest status, dog-approved morale (Cinnamon, QA).

slides.headline: Let's talk
slides.body: LinkedIn is the fastest path for recruiters and hiring managers. The hub links to live work if you want evidence before you reach out.
